audience: small businesses and bookkeepers who invoice clients and track expenses in Daftra

useCases.title: Find overdue invoices and open balances
useCases.text: List the invoices, filtered by client or payment status, most recent first. Open one invoice to read its lines and payments.

useCases.title: Review expenses by category and treasury
useCases.text: List the expenses for a period, with amount, vendor and category. Use the treasury list to see which account paid each one.

useCases.title: Check low stock in one warehouse
useCases.text: List the stores, then the products with their stock. Read the stock movements of one store to see what changed.

useCases.title: Look up a client and the notes on it
useCases.text: Search the clients by name, number, email or phone. Open one client, then read the notes recorded against it.

useCases.title: Create a client and record a note
useCases.text: Create a client with a business name, and add a note with the context of the first contact. Change the client later with a partial update.

useCases.title: Create an invoice for a client
useCases.text: Find the client and the products. Then create an invoice with line items. It is saved as a draft unless you set draft to false, and a final invoice posts to the books and stock.
